study.question: Does useful orientation in the within-block or across-block linear moment explain the loss from averaging reversed explicit details, while supplied compression and every other detail are held fixed?
study.hypothesis: Observation: the route factorial gave click AUC0.6684985129368424 for neither route reversed,0.6662811685797742 for details only,0.6684818197343733 for compression only and0.6662125025907809 for both. Thus the observed loss is concentrated in explicit details at this seed. Source inspection shows that detail reversal changes several summaries together and can move valid events across ten-slot block boundaries for partial histories. Hypothesis: signed coarse linear orientation contributes more frozen-recipe click utility than within-block linear orientation, beyond the unchanged match, quadratic and compression channels. This is an unverified attribution hypothesis, not a new architecture/novelty or mechanism-confirmation claim.

nearest_work.difference: Exact local architectural control: retain shared2B network, event-aligned raw views, all supplied-route selections, independent auxiliary normalization state and per-view objective; selectively multiply one or both second-view linear summary vectors by-1. No new learned parameters.

Prior reversal changes all five detail summaries and partial-block membership jointly. New interventions hold every nonselected summary fixed, separating two signed linear moment channels without claiming an actual event-reversal treatment.

Read archived primary text including local target-aware unnormalized pooling and Dice, and its reported unsuccessful LSTM observation. Inherit the adapted scorer/activation; that external sequence finding is not assumed to transfer. The present sign-symmetry attribution is within a later joint context/history model, not an exact DIN reproduction.

Read cached section2.3 of the primary benchmark describing stacked and layer-wise unified designs. Present model retains its inherited block summaries and context/history product rather than introducing one of those architectures. Original HyFormer/LONGER/MixFormer paper content is unverified here; no priority, superiority or reproduction claim.

inherited_components: All incumbent field/action embeddings, action-aware DIN scorer, ten-block uniform/feedback compression, target-match and five detail paths
Task-specific residual adapters and blockwise nonlinear context/history product correction
Primary/auxiliary scorer state separation, source gradient gates, folded training support and pruned inference
g1-r0065-neither_reversed_bridge complete-event layout preparation, supplied-only routing, shared2B normalization, probability mean and per-view BCE
study.proposed_difference: A parameter-free second-view sign operator, applied after inherited route selection, to local position summary and/or coarse block-linear summary only. Four cells (local,coarse,joint,none) share every other executable operation. Both negated and identity scaling have the same shape/work; actual cost must be measured. This is a matched-capacity2x2 intervention on second-view signs. The joint cell is simultaneous Z2 averaging, not independent Z2xZ2 averaging and not full event-order invariance.
predictions: If coarse orientation is the dominant useful signal, no_sign_bridge AUC minus coarse_sign_average AUC will exceed no_sign_bridge minus local_sign_average by at least0.0005 in this exploratory seed; a repeat is required before attributing a stable difference.

If the two selected linear directions jointly account for most of the prior detail-reversal loss, joint_sign_average will lose at least0.0015 click AUC versus no_sign_bridge; reproduction of the exact prior result is not predicted because other details and partial-block grouping are held fixed.

no_sign_bridge should reproduce the prior neither-reversed bridge at common weights and remain within0.0003 validation AUC at the frozen recipe; larger deviation blocks attribution pending implementation/optimization diagnosis.

All cells should retain32192421 total,31793216 embedding and399205 dense parameters, subject to host verification; doubled shared execution should cost roughly the prior600-second paired trials, without a predictive-efficiency improvement claim.
falsifiers: Coarse sign averaging has no reproducible utility loss, or local sign averaging loses as much/more: falsifies coarse-dominance for the tested model/recipe.

Joint sign averaging remains near the no-sign bridge while full detail reversal loses~0.0022: falsifies sufficiency of the two linear orientation channels and redirects attention to match/curvature/partial-block regrouping.

Common-weight bridge mismatch, changed parameter/state/input/source ownership, or changed nonselected detail invalidates interpretation; classify as implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence.
Effects vanish or reverse across paired authorized seeds: initial attribution remains preliminary; no significance or mechanism confirmation from this seed.
alternative_explanations: Single seed and adaptive selection across many trials; no independent replication or confidence interval yet
Per-view training and induced downstream Dice moments/optimization may mediate any loss; this is utility under the frozen recipe, not Bayes information identification
Joint sign averaging removes simultaneous orientation but retains relative signs; it is not independent averaging over all four sign combinations
Other summaries and block compression remain order sensitive; hybrid summary interventions need not correspond to any actual event permutation

Earlier local-duplicate coarse replacement lost AUC0.6658825132684709 versus0.6685268680116033, but it simultaneously removed/replaced linear and quadratic coarse directions; it does not isolate orientation.

Canonical content layouts, hashes, ring/dihedral/path controls and reversal-average/alternative-objective trajectories have not beaten the unchanged model. They limit effectiveness of those implementations, not every possible order-invariant model.
The incumbent improves click versus DIN but has lower auxiliary mean AUC; click selection cannot be presented as uniform four-task improvement.
